deployment_requirement.statement: Segments that a named team will act on, with a stated tolerance for segments that do not persist.

external_referent: A public dataset with known groups plus a domain owner's labelled segments; an independent replication of the stability result.

robustness.question: Do the same groups come back when the data is perturbed?
robustness.perturbation_or_signal: Gaussian noise at 0.1, 0.25 and 0.5 standard deviations; 50% row subsampling; dropping one feature at a time.
robustness.truth: Planted-group generators with known k; uniform noise with no groups as the null.
robustness.metric: Adjusted Rand index of labels against the unperturbed fit on shared rows; rate at which the stability gate calls noise stable.
robustness.acceptance_rule: Median ARI on planted data >= ari_floor at every perturbation level; the gate calls the noise null stable in <= false_stable_rate of runs.

drift.question: Is a change in the population noticed before segments are used?
drift.perturbation_or_signal: Move one centroid, merge two groups, add a new group, change group proportions.
drift.truth: The planted change, with null batches drawn from the training distribution.
drift.metric: Detection rate within max_batches batches; false alarms per 1000 null batches; population stability index of the assignment shares.
drift.acceptance_rule: Detection within max_batches batches at a rate >= detect_floor for each planted change, and false alarms <= alarm_ceiling per 1000 batches.

explanation.question: Do the cluster profiles name the features that separate the groups?
explanation.perturbation_or_signal: Planted generators in which only m of p features separate the groups.
explanation.metric: Precision at m of the features ranked by between-group effect size.
explanation.acceptance_rule: Precision at m >= precision_floor, with an interval over seeds that excludes chance.

monitoring.question: Can the deployed segmentation be watched with the signals that exist in production?
monitoring.perturbation_or_signal: Streams of batches with a planted drift at a known batch.
monitoring.truth: The batch at which the drift began.
monitoring.metric: Detection delay in batches for distance to centroid, assignment shares and silhouette on a sample.
monitoring.acceptance_rule: Median delay <= delay_ceiling batches with false alarms <= alarm_ceiling per 1000 batches.

parameter_rule: Every null parameter is fixed by the deployment owner and written into this file before the first line of the slice is built; it is never fitted to a result.
not_claimed: any benchmark in this file has been run
a stability score is not evidence that segments are useful to a business
